title: 第5章 直接整全套第6章 四倍暴击返还
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：财富自由从毕业开始第5章直接整全套（..）伴游？
恕我孤陋寡闻，实在没听说过这是什么……
周望沉思了一下，顺手在短视频的APP里点击了搜索，看到弹出来的词条介绍，他一眼恍然。
原来就是业务更广阔的“陪玩”
啊！
看词条的概括，她们承接一切吃喝玩乐的陪伴服务，还可以根据客户需求，提供私人订制的服务方案……
嗯，很有遐想空间。
周望顺便看了几条评论，这个行业好像风评很差的样子。
在周望一言不发的注视手机的时候，女孩疑惑的说道，“哥哥，你怎么不搭理人家呢？”
冉冉以为是周望没看上自己，想要换人，虽然这种情况对她来说极少发生，但青菜萝卜各有所爱嘛，总有人不喜欢她这款。
她有点小失望，因为眼前的男生真的很帅气，挺戳她的……癖好的，颜值这么耐打的客户也很少见。
但她又不是太失望，因为堪称奢侈品人形扫描机的她，一眼就能看出这男生没什么经济实力。
除了手上那台崭新的iPhone15PM，全身上下都是廉价的地摊货，也就意味着接了这个单子，也别想赚取什么额外的小费了。
嗯，说不定对方还要讲价……
周望抬起头来，正要跟女孩解释她找错了人，却看到了对方放在桌上的那个有着“PRADA”
logo的小号单肩包。
周望记得这好像也是一個奢侈品牌来着，而且对方的穿搭也不错，至少周望看着是赏心悦目，审美肯定比自己强。
于是周望又临时改了主意。
“不好意思，刚才在想事情……冉冉对吧，请问你是怎么收费的？”
“啊，小毛哥没跟你说吗？”

冉冉虽然意外，但还是介绍道，“就是一千块一天啦，从现在到晚上九点算一天，也可以按小时收费，但是得三小时起步，150一个小时哦。”
周望盘算了一下，确实比游戏陪玩贵多了，不过很适用他现在的情景。
用四五百买一个可能比较专业的意见，只要评分能拉高一点就是血赚。
“做什么都可以吗？”
周望问道。
“呃……哥哥，我们是纯绿色服务，过程中得保持互相尊重，不可以涩涩。”
冉冉没想到周望会问的这么直接，赶紧说道，说完后又冲周望笑着眨了眨眼睛，“但也许我们多见几次面，接触的久一点，投缘的话可以解锁更多的事情哦！”
周望知道对方误会了，不过他也没有解释，至于冉冉那点话语中的小心机，并不能让他心中泛起太多波澜。
投缘？投元吧……
他虽然以前不怎么祸害女生，但鼎盛时期周围也曾妖精环绕，什么类型的没见过？
只是缺乏实操经验罢了。
“是这样的，我打算买几身衣服，需要一个人帮我参考一下，你OK吗？时间的话就按小时计费吧。”
“买衣服啊，当然可以啦，这个简单！”
冉冉笑着点头。
“时间紧张，那我们走吧。”
有了军师陪同，周望也不想再喝咖啡了，起身就招呼着冉冉一起走向电梯。
恒隆的服饰品牌大多集中在一楼和二楼，一楼最多，周望决定直接从一楼逛起。
“我们要去哪里逛啊……要不要去南屏街，离这里也不远，那边的服装店还挺多的。”
出了电梯，冉冉主动开口，还很贴心的提出了建议。
她没有问周望的预算，但那边既有优衣库、杰克琼斯，又有森马、美特斯邦威，冉冉想着怎么都能满足周望这种年纪的男生的需求了……嗯，平价需求。

周望正要开口，冉冉的手机却突然响了起来，她冲周望示意了一下，就走到一边接起了电话。
“喂，小毛哥！”
“啊，客户临时取消了订单？那怎么……哦哦，我知道了，好的，我马上过去！”
冉冉有些惊讶的挂断了电话，她这才知道周望原来不是之前点单的客户。

Forgive me for being ignorant, I really have never heard of what this is...
Zhou Wang pondered for a moment, then clicked search on the short video APP. When he saw the entry introduction that popped up, he was suddenly enlightened.
It turns out to be a "accompanying person" with a broader business
Ah!
Looking at the summary of the entry, they undertake all accompanying services for eating, drinking and having fun, and can also provide customized service plans according to customer needs...
Well, there is a lot of room for imagination.
Zhou Wang took a look at a few comments and found that this industry seemed to have a very bad reputation.
While Zhou Wang was staring at the phone without saying a word, the girl asked doubtfully, "Brother, why are you ignoring me?"
Ran Ran thought that Zhou Wang didn't like her and wanted to replace her. Although this situation rarely happened to her, everyone had their own preferences for vegetables and radishes, and there were always people who didn't like hers.
She was a little disappointed, because the boy in front of her was really handsome, and he really poked her... It was rare to find a customer with such a good-looking appearance.
But she wasn't too disappointed, because as a luxury humanoid scanner, she could tell at a glance that this boy had little financial strength.
Except for the brand new iPhone 15PM in my hand, everything else is cheap street food, which means that if you take this order, you won’t be able to earn any extra tips.
Well, maybe the other party will still want to bargain...
Zhou Wang raised his head and was about to explain to the girl that she had found the wrong person, but he saw the one with "PRADA" on the table.
Small logo shoulder bag.
Zhou Wang remembered that this seemed to be a luxury brand, and the other party's clothes were also good. At least Zhou Wang looked pleasing to the eye, and his aesthetics must be better than his own.
So Zhou Wang temporarily changed his mind.
"Sorry, I was thinking about something just now... Ranran, right? How do you charge?"
"Ah, didn't Brother Xiaomao tell you?"
Although Ran Ran was surprised, she still introduced, "It's just one thousand yuan a day. From now to nine o'clock in the evening, you can also charge by the hour, but it has to start at three hours, 150 an hour."
Zhou Wang calculated it and found that it was indeed much more expensive than playing with the game, but it was very suitable for his current situation.
Spend four or five hundred dollars to buy a possibly more professional opinion. As long as the rating can be raised a little bit, it will be a real profit.
"Can I do anything?"
Zhou Wang asked.
"Uh...brother, we are a pure green service. We must maintain mutual respect during the process and don't be astringent."
Ran Ran didn't expect Zhou Wang to ask so directly, so she said quickly, and then smiled at Zhou Wang and winked, "But maybe we meet a few more times and stay in contact for a longer time. If we get along, we can unlock more things!"
Zhou Wang knew that the other party had misunderstood, but he did not explain it. As for the carefulness in Ran Ran's words, it could not make him feel too much.
Hit it off? Bet money...
Although he didn't harm girls much before, he was surrounded by fairies during his heyday. What kind of monsters have he not seen before?
It’s just a lack of practical experience.
"It's like this. I plan to buy a few clothes and I need someone to help me make reference. Are you okay? If it's time, I'll charge you by the hour."
"Buying clothes, of course you can, it's easy!"
Ranran smiled and nodded.
"Time is tight, let's go."
With the military advisor accompanying him, Zhou Wang didn't want to drink coffee anymore. He stood up and greeted Ran Ran and walked to the elevator together.
Most of Hang Lung's clothing brands are concentrated on the first and second floors, with the most on the first floor. Zhou Wang decided to start shopping directly from the first floor.
"Where should we go shopping... Should we go to Nanping Street? It's not far from here. There are quite a few clothing stores over there."
After getting out of the elevator, Ran Ran took the initiative to speak and made thoughtful suggestions.
she didn't askZhou Wang's budget is limited, but there are Uniqlo, Jack Jones, Semir, and Metersbonwe. Ran Ran thought about how to meet the needs of boys of Zhou Wang's age...well, affordable needs.
Just as Zhou Wang was about to speak, Ran Ran's cell phone rang suddenly. She gestured to Zhou Wang, then walked aside and answered the phone.
"Hey, Brother Xiaomao!"
"Ah, the customer canceled the order temporarily? Then what... Oh, I understand, okay, I'll be there right away!"
Ran Ran hung up the phone in surprise, and then she realized that Zhou Wang was not the customer who had placed the order before.
